name: beaver-steps
$comment: Open-loop responses of the FDC 'Beaver' (45 m/s, 6000 ft) to the thesis' control inputs on each axis and the engine. Generated by design/build_model.py; see the README.

annotations.text: **Airframe.** RigidBody3D on its principal axes (the product of inertia Jxz tilts them 1.16 deg from the body x axis); the air and engine wrench (BeaverWrench) is a modulated source on the body, applied in the geometric body frame through the Mount.

**Drivetrain (bond graph, our addition).** 1-junction Crank: engine torque P(pz, n, rho)/w (MSe), crank + propeller inertia I = 12 kg m^2, the propeller's torque -Q (MSe) from the governor of the constant-speed propeller, tachometer (SpeedSensor, which makes the bond graph rotational). Global `drivetrain`: 1 the thrust comes from the shaft power Q w, 0 from the source's algebraic power at the commanded rpm (exact FDC).

parameters.name: drivetrain
parameters.description: Thrust from the drivetrain's shaft power (1), or the source's algebraic power at the prescribed rpm (0, exact FDC; the validation mode)

parameters.name: step_df
parameters.description: Flap ramp (deg in 3 s from 1 s)

parameters.name: step_n
parameters.description: Engine speed ramp (rpm in 4 s from 1 s)

parameters.name: step_pz
parameters.description: Manifold pressure ramp (inch Hg in 2 s from 1 s)

options.text: The thesis' inputs on each axis and the engine, from the 45 m/s, 6000 ft trim. Change the sizes; switch the drivetrain on to let the shaft lag the rpm command.
